import anthropic

client = anthropic.Anthropic()

def gen_until(prompt: str, stop: str = "{{stop_token}}") -> str:
    msg = client.messages.create(
        model="{{model_name}}",
        max_tokens=512,
        stop_sequences=[stop],
        messages=[{"role": "user", "content": prompt}],
    )
    return msg.content[0].text

if __name__ == "__main__":
    print(gen_until("List 3 fruits, then write END"))
